input: skill contains n positive integers at most 1000000. Let H be the maximum or zero; require floor(n/2)*H*H safe. Empty input returns zero and odd length returns -1 as declared extensions. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Sum of pairwise skill products after dividing all players into two-person teams with identical team skill sums, or -1 if impossible.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state. Sorting copies skill; no team objects or input rearrangement are produced.
numeric: Each candidate team sum is at most 2000000. Products and accumulated chemistry are bounded by floor(n/2)*H^2. Sorted smallest/largest pairing is necessary for a common sum and determines chemistry. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n log(n+1)+1) time and O(n+1) auxiliary copied-array/sort space; odd/empty inputs return in O(1). Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 554 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.

Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed.
